errors.error_description: The combinational always block omits mask_reg from its sensitivity list while reading it, causing a sensitivity list mismatch.
In the always_comb block, hold_vec is assigned only in the lock branch without an else/default assignment, inferring a latch.
The sequential block uses always @(clk or rst) with an internal if (clk) gating, mixing level-sensitive behavior with edge-triggered intent.
